name: com.perfboarddesigner/mcp
title: Perfboard Designer
description: Design perfboard and stripboard layouts, check the wiring and get a link to open them in the editor.

environmentVariables.name: PERFBOARD_EDITOR_URL
environmentVariables.description: Where board links open, e.g. http://localhost:3000/app/ for your own copy of the editor. Defaults to https://perfboarddesigner.com/app/.

environmentVariables.name: PERFBOARD_PROJECTS_URL
environmentVariables.description: Where short links store projects, or off for no short links. Defaults to https://projects.perfboarddesigner.com.

environmentVariables.name: PERFBOARD_IMAGE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Where board picture links point, or off for none. Defaults to https://mcp.perfboarddesigner.com/render.svg.
